notes.title: Pit Blocks 3D - Update 1.3 - Free Mode
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33434395/e224101b3e7da16bdda750274047e0893dbd1835.png

Update 1.3 introduces the new Free mode, where players will be able to play the game without concerning themselves about descending bricks. You will be able to plan your moves, taking your time doing so.

The current brick that you will be manipulating will not descend and will remain in place until you tell it to rush downwards. While the clock will tick, it will not automatically descend your brick when the remaining seconds reach 0. As with previous versions of Pit Blocks 3D, the timer is only a measure of when your pit will move to the next level.

This mode is best suited for those who want to take it easy and just want to match cubes and bricks to complete the pit puzzle. It's a great mode to pass your time and challenge your critical thinking without the worry of a ticking timer.

For those who prefer the time rush, the Race mode is still available for play.

Update 1.3

[olist]
Mode changes

Free mode

The free mode is now available
Bricks no longer descend based on time
Bricks descend when the user tells them to using the "rush" key



Race mode

This mode has been renamed from "Freestyle" mode to "Race" mode so as to not be confused with the new "Free" mode


[/olist]

notes.title: Pit Blocks 3D - Seasonal Update 1.2 - Halloween
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33434395/4e136ae4dc2c0357404f3a616b717778a9587f43.png
Update 1.2 introduces Seasonal Events, starting with this year's Halloween! The blocks have turned to pumpkins, and they're trying to escape! Help them out by clearing rows, or even better, clearing the pit! The Halloween environment is now playable!

Update 1.2

[olist]
Seasonal Event

Halloween

The Halloween Environment is now playable, which features a haunted village
This environment is non-interactable and is locked in for the duration of the event
All blocks are now carved pumpkins of different design


[/olist]

Check out the video below for a preview of the event.
Note that the video is playing at 500% speed... just in case you thought anyone can be that fast!

notes.title: Pit Blocks 3D - Update 1.1
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33434395/1ab1fcd94a9e2eef083a032729c51a02d0795bcb.png

We have released Update 1.1 which introduces new features and new options that can help you get a richer experience when playing PitBlocks3D. Details are outlined below.

Update 1.1
[olist]
Alternate game style - available in the Options Menu
	
	Top-down
		
		Camera has a static (unable to be moved) position and will stare down the pit
		Each playable block is wireframe
		Each dropped brick is solid coloured
		
	

New Options
		
		No story text
			
			Avoid scrolling text, message text, and button-clicking so that you can jump right into the game
			Can still unlock story cards
			
		Same-coloured bricks
			
			Can help players memorize bricks by colour
			
		Static row colours
			
			Each pit level has its own colour
			Each dropped brick converts to the colour of the level it is dropped in
			
		

Missing space/spot identifier
	
	A clear missing space/spot identifier will be implemented in order to help the player complete a row level
		
		Useful if the player missed a spot and they cannot find it in order to fill the row and lower the level
		All dropped blocks become wireframe and all "missing" spots become solid
		
	

Increased difficulty
	
	Option to disable pausing (this would result in a greater score)
		
		Remains applicable for the entire duration of current gameplay
		
	
[/olist]

notes.title: Pit Blocks 3D - Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33434395/b0e0be7afe470da8004f0af93ec7722a68df2d9f.png

Hey there Everyone! How's it blocking?

We recently posted an update to PB3D that fixes a few mouse / gamepad issues, as well as a score mechanic. Details are outlined below.

Update 1.0.1


Score mechanic for Basic difficulty now adds the area of the Pit as a score bonus for clearing it.

Score mechanic for Advanced difficulty now adds half the current score to the player's score when clearing a Pit.

Expert difficulty doubles the current player's score when a Pit is cleared.

Fixed an issue where the player wouldn't be able to scroll the in-game achievement window if the game was paused.

Fixed an issue where the player would be able to rotate the camera when the Leaderboards or Story Cards menu was open.

Fixed an issue where the "B" button of the gamepad would not return from any menu if a Tutorial instance was in progress.


In our next post this week, we will be posting our update roadmap!

Thank you all, and enjoy Pit Blocks 3D!
